# Houzz
> Houzz helps homeowners find inspiration, shop for home products, and hire renovation and design professionals, while offering software for pros.

Houzz combines a large home design photo library, product marketplace, local professional directory, editorial advice, and business software for construction and design firms. The platform serves both homeowners planning projects and professionals managing leads, clients, and operations.

## Homeowners
- [Houzz Home](https://www.houzz.com/): Main entry point for inspiration, products, professionals, and remodeling resources.
- [Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos): Browse home design and remodeling photos by room, style, and feature.
- [Shop](https://www.houzz.com/products): Explore furniture, decor, lighting, bath, kitchen, and outdoor products.
- [Find Professionals](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/probr0-bo~): Search local home improvement and design professionals by specialty.
- [Stories](https://www.houzz.com/magazine): Read editorial articles, renovation advice, and design trend coverage.
- [Discuss](https://www.houzz.com/discussions): Join community conversations about remodeling, decorating, and home improvement questions.

## Professional Directory
- [All Professionals](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/probr0-bo~): Directory hub for contractors, designers, architects, and specialty trades.
- [Architects & Building Designers](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/architect/probr0-bo~t_11784): Find architects and residential building designers by location and reviews.
- [Interior Designers & Decorators](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/interior-designer/probr0-bo~t_11785): Browse interior design professionals for decorating and space planning projects.
- [General Contractors](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/general-contractor/probr0-bo~t_11786): Search general contractors for renovations, additions, and construction work.
- [Home Builders](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/probr0-bo~t_11823): Discover custom home builders and residential construction companies.
- [Design-Build Firms](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/design-build/probr0-bo~t_11793): Find integrated design-build companies for planning and construction services.

## Kitchen, Bath, and Remodeling Pros
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Designers](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/kitchen-and-bath/probr0-bo~t_11790): Locate specialists in kitchen layouts, bath design, and cabinetry planning.
- [Kitchen Remodelers](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/kitchen-remodelers/probr0-bo~t_34334): Find contractors focused on kitchen renovation and installation projects.
- [Bathroom Remodelers](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/kitchen-and-bath-remodelers/probr0-bo~t_11825): Search bathroom remodeling professionals for upgrades and full renovations.
- [Home Remodeling Companies](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/home-remodeling/probr0-bo~t_34257): Browse firms handling whole-home and room-by-room remodeling projects.
- [Home Additions & Extension Companies](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/home-additions-and-extensions/probr0-bo~t_34259): Find contractors for additions, expansions, and extension planning.
- [Basement Remodeling Companies](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/basement-remodelers/probr0-bo~t_34261): Discover specialists for basement finishing and lower-level remodels.

- [Countertop Contractors](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/custom-countertops/probr0-bo~t_33909): Search countertop professionals for fabrication and installation services.
- [Flooring Contractors](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/hardwood-flooring-dealers/probr0-bo~t_28349): Browse flooring specialists for hardwood and other floor installations.
- [Custom Cabinet Companies](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/cabinets/probr0-bo~t_11829): Locate cabinet makers and custom storage professionals.
- [Carpenters](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/carpenter/probr0-bo~t_11831): Find carpenters for trim, framing, built-ins, and woodwork.
- [Glass & Shower Door Contractors](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/glass-and-shower-door-dealers/probr0-bo~t_27203): Search glass specialists for shower enclosures, mirrors, and custom glazing.

## Inspiration and Ideas
- [Photo Library](https://www.houzz.com/photos): Search visual inspiration across rooms, products, and design styles.
- [Kitchen Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos/kitchen): Browse kitchen inspiration for layouts, cabinets, and finishes.
- [Bathroom Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos/bathroom): Explore bathroom ideas for vanities, tile, and fixtures.
- [Living Room Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos/living-room): View living room designs, furniture arrangements, and decor ideas.
- [Bedroom Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos/bedroom): Discover bedroom inspiration for layouts, storage, and finishes.
- [Landscape Photos](https://www.houzz.com/photos/landscape): Find outdoor design ideas for gardens, patios, and yards.

## Products and Shopping
- [Shop All Products](https://www.houzz.com/products): Product marketplace for furniture, decor, renovation, and outdoor categories.
- [Furniture](https://www.houzz.com/products/furniture): Shop sofas, tables, beds, storage, and other home furnishings.
- [Lighting](https://www.houzz.com/products/lighting): Browse chandeliers, pendants, sconces, and other lighting products.
- [Kitchen & Dining](https://www.houzz.com/products/kitchen-and-dining): Explore dining furniture, cookware, and kitchen accessories.
- [Bath Products](https://www.houzz.com/products/bath-products): Shop vanities, faucets, mirrors, and bathroom accessories.
- [Outdoor Products](https://www.houzz.com/products/outdoor): Find patio furniture, planters, lighting, and outdoor living items.

## Community and Editorial
- [Stories](https://www.houzz.com/magazine): Editorial hub for renovation advice, home tours, and design trends.
- [Discussions](https://www.houzz.com/discussions): Community forum for homeowner questions and peer advice.
- [Advice](https://www.houzz.com/advice): Browse practical guidance for remodeling, decorating, and home projects.
- [Ideabooks](https://www.houzz.com/ideabooks): Save and organize inspiration images and products into collections.

## Houzz Pro
- [Houzz Pro](https://www.houzz.com/pro): Business software for contractors, designers, and residential construction professionals.
- [Software for Builders](https://www.houzz.com/pro/builders): Tools for home builders to manage projects, clients, and workflows.
- [Software for Remodelers](https://www.houzz.com/pro/remodelers): Business management platform for remodeling companies and contractors.
- [Software for Interior Designers](https://www.houzz.com/pro/interior-designers): Client, proposal, and project tools for interior design firms.
- [Software for Architects](https://www.houzz.com/pro/architects): Practice management and client collaboration tools for architects.
- [Software for Design-Build Firms](https://www.houzz.com/pro/design-build-firms): Integrated business software for design-build operations.

## Account and Business Resources
- [Join as a Pro](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/join): Sign up to create a professional profile and reach homeowners.
- [Get Started with Houzz Pro](https://www.houzz.com/pro/getStarted): Start a trial or onboarding flow for Houzz Pro software.
- [Pro Directory](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/probr0-bo~): Public-facing directory where pros list services and portfolios.
- [Houzz Pro Login](https://www.houzz.com/pro/login): Access Houzz Pro account tools and business management features.
